entries.name: WP2 plug-in foundations
entries.why: Measured growth of the start (plan allowance 1.0 KB): the emit sites in main.ts and hud-combat.ts, the sending end of the event bus, the features loader with its one retry, bossApproach, and addPhrases in i18n.ts. The bus, the services and every feature load after Start.

entries.name: WP10 hero gait blend
entries.why: Measured growth of the start (plan allowance 0.3 KB): hero-motion.ts, the blend between the idle and the walk pose that runs from the first frame, in place of the switch in world.ts animatePlayer. The lean-in, the settle, the fidgets, the sit and the clips load after Start (features/hero-idle.ts).

entries.name: WP9 hit feel hooks
entries.why: Measured growth of the start against staging f6a377e (English 798,597 -> 798,764, Vietnamese 931,989 -> 932,156; plan allowance 0.5 KB; against the staging it was first built on it measured 455): the press buffer, the settings-rows registry and its two calls in settings(), the hit-stop spending in frame() with world.hold, the hooks on the effects (rig, feel, punch, flashes), the zoom punch, and the style rule that keeps the hurt flash and the warp at half until the features have read the Flashes choice. The stop table, the kick, the pitch ladder, the shake model, the Screen shake and Flashes rows and the haptics load after Start (hit-stop.ts, shake.ts, features/comfort.ts).

entries.name: WP6 toy finish
entries.why: Measured growth of the start against staging at the merge (the plan's 0.3 KB was an estimate; it was 507 bytes against the staging WP6 was built on): the five colour steps, the ramp-colour shader patch and the icon/mirror swap in toon.ts, the neutral light steps under a cool sun, the ground colour correction and the gloss in look.ts, the look switch, and in crop-cards.ts (world chunk, loaded before Start) the bake at the camera pitch, the footprint cap, the centring of lopsided crops and the re-bake when the camera angle is changed. Two slimming passes saved about 50 bytes; the rest would mean cutting one of these.

entries.name: WP24 fair rewards and true words
entries.why: Measured growth of the start against staging 48da5cb (English 797,451 -> 797,634, Vietnamese 930,833 -> 931,026). The plan allowed 0.1 KB (102 bytes): this is 81 and 91 bytes over it, after the level-20 News sentence was cut back to its old length. What is left is rule code that both sides run and the hook: the bounty cap with the creature kept in the bounty log (progression.ts; the zone table now sits beside the spawn tables in enemy-types.ts), the soothed rate in grantColossusReward and the roar bonus on the EXP paid (colossus-rewards.ts, shared with the server and folded into a start chunk), the one-line well hook in main.ts, and '1 day in a row' with its Vietnamese. Loaded on demand, not in the start: the well's view (colossus-well-ui chunk, 1.8 KB gzip with the gift's clock guard and the awake-day rule; the plan row says 1.5 KB), its Vietnamese (features-vi, +1.0 KB of that chunk's 15 KB) and Automatic's pay rule (colossus.ts, the modes chunk). news.json is 20 bytes smaller.

entries.name: Integration rounding (batches 1-4)
entries.why: Each package measured its growth against the staging it was built on; gzip deltas do not add up exactly. Measured on staging after merging WP6 and WP24: Vietnamese start 931,981 against a summed limit of 931,979 (2 bytes over). 16 bytes cover that rounding; no code was added.

entries.name: WP18 round stars
entries.why: The plan's ledger line for this package was 'space +1 program' for a runtime star sprite. As built there is no new program: all three star layers wear the round map, so their one points program changed instead of a second one being added (programs 7, as baselined; 31 draws and 65,990 triangles exact). What is added is the sprite itself: one 128 x 128 canvas texture, drawn once when the space view is built (the same soft round glow the halos use, with a solid middle).

entries.name: WP18 our own colours
entries.why: Measured growth of the start against staging 66d897e (English 798,864 -> 799,877, Vietnamese 932,256 -> 933,269; plan allowance 0.1 KB; it was 445 bytes before the review round). Colour values the world reads as it is built, so they cannot load after Start: about 75 colours that did not exist before (our own ground colours for seven planets, which used to come from the planet facts; the island, dapple and sea colours of Ocean and Cloud, which were written into environment-art.ts; the warm shade under forest, swamp and canyon trees; the paint of the Crocodile King, King Bear and the Snow Yeti; eight bosses' own colours, kept in the table so the look switch turns them back; the blue basalt), and the code that applies them (paint by material name in creature-art.ts and space-view.ts, the boss colours put on as the page loads, the dappled island top, the round star map, the smooth stand-in rock, the look switch). The old tables are kept for a before and after in dev and perf builds only (a statically false branch in the shipped build: 0 bytes).

entries.name: WP12 creature voices and warnings
entries.why: Measured growth of the start against staging ef9501e, with WP9 merged (English 798,764 -> 798,860, Vietnamese 932,156 -> 932,252; the plan allows 0.1 KB): hooks and fallbacks only. world.ts tells a wind-up where a creature is seen to start one (onTelegraph, also for a guest in a room), main.ts forwards it as the telegraph event, plays the alert beep until the creatures have their own voices (graph.creatures), names a pet hit where it is played, and hands the features the health bar as a part of 1 (services.health); sfx.ts plays the hit for petHit and the hurt cry for roar until their recipes have come, and hands the stingers the options of a play (a detune, a pan). The voices, the wind-up warning, the roar, the pet hit, the heartbeat, the red edge and its sheet load after Start: the audio features in a lazy chunk of their own (features-audio, 12.5 KB gzip), the rest in the features chunk (7.5 KB gzip with the comfort rows of WP9).

entries.name: WP17 first fight and danger signs
entries.why: Measured growth of the start against staging 0885396 (English 799,877 -> 800,206, Vietnamese 933,269 -> 933,598). The plan allowed 0.3 KB (307 bytes); this is 22 over it, and about 60 of it is the review's guard that keeps the press which opens a dialog from also pressing a button of it (main.ts tapThrough, for every dialog). The rest in the start: the fight flag of attack-intent.ts and the three hooks in main.ts (world.lesson fight, swing and bite), the banner-only option of showZone, the spots of the first fight's creatures clear of the village's things (first-run.ts) and three more saved ids, the red band in ground.ts, and in world.ts a creature's own warning ring and the first fight's creatures going for the explorer inside the village. Loaded after Start: the rule for when a fight is on (fight-state.ts), the waiting swings, the ring and its bite, the tips, the first-win burst and event, the danger chip and its red look and the banner before the fence (features/tutorial-fight.ts) and the Vietnamese (features-vi).
